segs.text: Imagine sending money to family abroad, and it arriving in minutes, on a Sunday night.
parts: Imagine sending money to family abroad,
and it arriving in minutes, on a Sunday night.

segs.text: Crypto prices swing wildly. Nobody wants their rent money to drop ten percent overnight.
parts: Nobody wants their rent money to drop ten percent overnight.

segs.text: A stablecoin is a crypto token designed to stay worth one fixed amount, usually one US dollar.
parts: A stablecoin is a crypto token designed to stay worth one fixed amount,

segs.text: Most are backed by reserves: for every token, the issuer says it holds a dollar in cash or short-term government bonds.
parts: for every token, the issuer says it holds a dollar in cash or short-term government bonds.

segs.text: Because they move on blockchains, they can cross borders at any hour, and settle in minutes.
parts: Because they move on blockchains, they can cross borders at any hour,

segs.text: Today, more than three hundred billion dollars' worth of stablecoins are in circulation.
parts: Today, more than three hundred billion dollars' worth of stablecoins are in circulation.

segs.text: The catch: a stablecoin is only as good as its reserves and its issuer. Some have lost their peg. And the rules differ from country to country.
parts: The catch: a stablecoin is only as good as its reserves and its issuer.
Some have lost their peg. And the rules differ from country to country.

segs.text: A stablecoin isn't an investment that grows. It's a digital dollar that moves fast.
parts: A stablecoin isn't an investment that grows.
It's a digital dollar that moves fast.
